description: Workflow Health indexes workflows for Search Hub without conflating runnable flows, validation cases, and action fragments.

requirements.title: Publish Typed Workflow Search Leaves
requirements.description: Workflow Health must publish `workflow.flow`, `workflow.test`, and `workflow.fragment` leaves so Search Hub can rank runnable flows for do/run intents, validation cases for prove/validate intents, and fragments only as dependency context.

validation.notes: Search shaping tests assert leaf type, intent routing, ranking hints, dependency hiding, and safe observer preference.
`search-hub query "create project workflow" --type workflow.flow` returns flow leaves and validate/prove queries return test leaves.

title: Workflow search and action discovery
